notes: Eight choices for every part of your look: new bodies (Reactor, Sculpted, Tin Can, Jetpack, Circuit and more), helmets (Centurion, Halo, Top Hat...), a Cyclops eye, five new hammers and swords, and new hammer slams and bomb blasts, from Crystal Spikes to a Black Hole. "Big" and "Huge" bodies are now Reactor and Sculpted. Players still on 0.9.0 see the default in place of the new ones.
The Play menu puts online first: Casual is the big button, and vs Bots moves to the bottom under Offline. In a party, bot matches and private games wait until you leave it.
The Mac App Store and TestFlight version now signs in to Game Center, so online play works on it. When you're not signed in, the menu says where to do it.
